findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: set_profile, run_lint, get_law, claim_trial_key, submit_feedback, upload_lint_run · Private data: run_lint, upload_lint_run · Public sink: run_lint, get_law, claim_trial_key, submit_feedback, upload_lint_run · Destructive: set_profile, run_lint, claim_trial_key, submit_feedback, upload_lint_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: set_profile, run_lint, get_law, claim_trial_key, submit_feedback, upload_lint_run · Private data: run_lint, upload_lint_run · Public sink: run_lint, get_law, claim_trial_key, submit_feedback, upload_lint_run · Destructive: set_profile, run_lint, claim_trial_key, submit_feedback, upload_lint_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
